dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Several prominent closed 'O' structures on the mid-lateral flank exhibit jagged, high-contrast light-grey perimeters with a sharp gradient transition from the dark exterior pelage to a lighter, mottled interior. Multiple interlocking 'C' shapes are concentrated on the upper dorsal region with irregular, high-frequency edge boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of interconnected high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated along the dorsal ridge, transitioning to more discrete, isolated clusters of solid high-intensity pixels towards the posterior flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the most prominent mid-lateral annuli form an obtuse triangle, while a series of high-intensity blobs along the dorsal-lateral boundary form a linear, non-equidistant chain.

other_distinctive_markers: Sharp visual demarcation between the uniform dark-intensity pixels of the head/neck region and the high-contrast, complex topological patterning of the mid-body.
